scope.en: Modern state, province and territory outlines from Natural Earth release 5.1.1 (2022), shown only as an optional geographic reference. They do not reconstruct the selected historical year, Indigenous territories, treaty areas or continuous personal residence. US overseas territories are outside this layer.
